Root cause identified

Investigated the ECOM loader code (c049gap, branch Production) and confirmed the following:

  • voidticketflg is hardcoded to 0 in ARDM_10_Header.sql:82 for all ECOM transactions. No cancellation logic exists.

  • ord_typ CASE block in the Header loader has no CANCELLED branch — cancelled orders fall to ELSE 99, loading as stdtransactiontype = 99 with voidticketflg = 0.

  • Confirmed against DB: zero ECOM transactions across 356M+ rows have voidticketflg = 1. All 6 reported orders present in ardm_049.ardm_header with voidticketflg = 0, netsalesamount = 0.00.

  • marc_ord_un_sts (the unit status table) only surfaces VALIDATED at item level via x_onlineorderstatus — no cancellation signal reaches the Header.

Fix required: To add a CANCELLED branch to the ord_typ CASE in ARDM_10_Header.sql to set voidticketflg = 1. Exact ord_typ value for cancellations needs to be confirmed from a raw archive file on P-INGEST before the fix is written.

Backfill may also be required for the 6 existing orders already in ARDM.

Thanks & Regards,

Appriss Retail Support

","created":"2026-08-10T02:47:52.347-0400","updated":"2026-08-10T02:47:52.347-0400","updateAuthor":{"accountId":"712020:036f5eba-7ec8-462c-b21b-264f8e744092","displayName":"Bikash Kumar"},"jsdPublic":true},{"id":"3283069","author":{"accountId":"712020:036f5eba-7ec8-462c-b21b-264f8e744092","displayName":"Bikash Kumar"},"body":"

Issue Summary
Cancelled NGCC orders for GAP customer "bala Kotipalli" are appearing as valid purchase transactions in the Identify portal. Cancelled/voided transactions should not be visible in Identify as they are not completed transactions.

Investigation Steps

  1. DB Investigation (ardm_049.ardm_header)


Queried the 6 reported cancelled orders (1PT8FK4, 1PT66GJ, 1PSYPFG, 1PSLN5N, 1PSG88, 1PPSTFK) directly in ARDM:

  • All 6 orders present with voidticketflg = 0

  • netsalesamount = 0.00 on all records

  • stdtransactiontype = 99 (falls to ELSE in the ord_typ CASE block)

  • serialno = 'ECOM-GDP' confirming these are ECOM feed transactions

  1. Broader DB Check


Queried all ECOM-GDP transactions grouped by voidticketflg — 356M+ ECOM transactions, not a single one has voidticketflg = 1. Confirms voidticketflg is hardcoded and never set dynamically for ECOM.

  1. Item Level Check


Queried ardm_049.ardm_item for the 6 orders via x_onlineorderstatus — all item lines show VALIDATED, no cancellation status surfaced at item level either.

  1. Code Review (c049gap, branch: Production)


Reviewed load_ecom_scripts/ARDM_10_Header.sql:

  • Line 82: voidticketflg hardcoded to 0::bit for all ECOM transactions

  • ord_typ CASE block only handles SALES/RETURN/REFUND/EXCHANGE — no CANCELLED branch

  • Cancelled orders fall to ELSE 99, loading as stdtransactiontype = 99 with voidticketflg = 0

Probable Root Cause
The ECOM loader hardcodes voidticketflg = 0 for all online transactions with no cancellation handling. Cancelled orders from GAP's NGCC feed fall through as stdtransactiontype = 99 and load into ARDM as live transactions, making them visible in Identify.

Fix Required

  • Code change in ARDM_10_Header.sql to add CANCELLED branch to ord_typ CASE block, setting voidticketflg = 1

  • Confirm exact ord_typ value GAP sends for cancellations from raw archive on P-INGEST

Thanks & Regards,

Appriss Retail Support
